calculation.mesh: 96x96x96 fine k, 300 K, degaussw 0.03 eV, Gamma-c only, 13 Wannier bands, scalar
calculation.quantity: sqrt(sum over 3 degenerate TO modes and 9 channels |Gamma|^2)

scissor.definition: experimental 300 K gap (1.344 eV, Vurgaftman 2001) minus PBE direct gap on the 703-point path (0.446 eV); applied to the photon axis only

experiment_dielectric_function.source: Aspnes & Studna, Phys. Rev. B 27, 985 (1983), <100> undoped InP, room temperature
experiment_dielectric_function.literature_note: E2 of InP is usually quoted near 5.0-5.1 eV; the tabulated eps2 peaks at 4.70 eV where E0' and E2 overlap

resonance_comparison.note: with a single rigid shift fixed by the fundamental gap, both kernel resonances are compared to independent higher critical points

mechanism_check_Mante2020.source: P.-A. Mante et al., ACS Photonics 7, 1923 (2020), arXiv:1909.02238; InP nanowires, 550 nm/35 fs pump, 720 nm probe
mechanism_check_Mante2020.finding: coherent TO amplitude independent of doping (intrinsic to 4.6e19 cm-3) -> generated and detected by second-order processes; Reststrahlen-band modes scale with surface field (TDFS)
mechanism_check_Mante2020.relation_to_kernel: the computed kernel is exactly the bulk second-order (Raman-type) generation channel; surface-field channels are outside its scope
mechanism_check_Mante2020.prediction: pumping near E1 (~3.21 eV) should drive the TO mode about 4.3x more strongly than the 550 nm pump used by Mante et al.

known_model_mismatches: No measured pump-energy scan of a coherent phonon exists for bulk InP; the located experiments use one pump energy each.
The calculation is Gamma-c only, scalar-relativistic (no spin-orbit; InP Delta0 = 0.11 eV), PBE bands with a rigid scissor, and 0.03 eV smearing.
At exactly q = 0 the LO-TO splitting is not resolved; the kernel's three optical modes share the TO-like frequency.
Nanowire (Mante 2020) and bulk differ: nanowire TO is red-shifted by ~7 cm-1 and field-enhancement/depolarization in ~100 nm wires affect absolute amplitudes.
Excitonic effects are absent (weak in bulk InP, exciton binding ~5 meV).
